description: Routes by Transportation Sites is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. This dataset allows users to link the information in the Route dataset to the information in the Transportation Site dataset. Please note that because OPT does not design routes for Pre-K service, those routes are not included in this dataset. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Transportation. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Education (DOE). The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
